login.title: Sign in
login.failed: The login identifier or the password is wrong, or the account is not active.

invitation.title: Set your password
invitation.intro: You were invited to {{hostname}}. Choose a password to activate your account.
invitation.done: Your account is active. Sign in with your login identifier and the password you chose.
invitation.invalid: This invitation is not valid any more. Ask your administrator for a new one.

errors.title: Something went wrong
errors.forbidden: Your account does not have permission to see this page.
errors.notFound: There is no page at this address.
errors.sessionEnded: Your session has ended. Sign in again.

grid.capped: The page size was limited to {{max}} rows (asked for more than the API allows); showing {{size}} per page.

accents.primary: The platform accent: the main action on a page, links and the focus ring.
accents.identity: The Identity module: its opener, its navigation mark and its pattern.
accents.console: The tenant console: organisation units, roles, entitlements, flags and settings.
accents.success: Something worked: a saved record, an activated account. Always with a word or an icon.
accents.warning: Something needs attention before it goes wrong. Always with a word or an icon.
accents.danger: Something failed, or will destroy data if confirmed. Always with a word or an icon.
accents.info: Something worth knowing that needs no action. Always with a word or an icon.

neutral.ink: Text and strokes: a near-black with a hint of blue, and its light counterpart on dark paper.
neutral.paper: Surfaces: a warm off-white, and a cool near-black. Pure black and pure white are not used.
neutral.gray: The light scheme greys: hovers at 0, borders at 4, dimmed text at 6.
neutral.dark: The dark scheme greys: the ink at 0, dimmed text at 2, borders at 4, the paper at 7.

gallery.title: Design gallery
gallery.intro: Every token and every themed component, in both schemes and both densities. Development builds only; the accessibility scan reads this page.

colour.scalesIntro: Ten shades per colour, lightest first, generated from one hue and one chroma on one lightness table.
colour.pairsIntro: The pairs Mantine renders from the tokens, measured as the browser paints them. Text needs 4.5:1; a border or a focus ring needs 3:1 and is shown as a box.
colour.swatch: A box drawn in the foreground colour on the background colour

type.sample: The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog.
type.heading: Heading level {{order}}
type.display: Display titles, for the moments only

space.durations: Quick, {{quick}} ms, for a change under the pointer; calm, {{calm}} ms, for something that arrives or leaves.

components.textDescription: Shown to other people in your tenant.
components.alertText: Status is never colour alone: a title and an icon say what it is.
components.paperText: A bordered surface for a record or a form.
components.textBody: Body text in the reading family, at the size of the work.
components.textDimmed: Dimmed text for hints and secondary lines, still at 4.5:1.
components.anchorLead: A link is underlined, not only coloured:

grid.label: Sample records
grid.intro: Twenty rows from memory, paged by the grid as the API would; the density switch changes the row height.
grid.name: Name

views.brokenMessage: The gallery asked for an error on purpose.

drawings.marksIntro: Seeded from the hostname, so every tenant has something of its own with no configuration: acme and bravo, side by side.
drawings.patternsIntro: Symmetry 6, 8 and 12 at four rings, and the hatch that shades a drawing.
drawings.illustrationsIntro: Eleven drawings in one hand (brief section 3), each with its accessible name; the loader draws itself in unless motion is reduced.

illustrations.nothingYet: An open, empty box: nothing here yet.
illustrations.nothingFound: A magnifier over a blank page: nothing matches.
illustrations.noAccess: A closed door and a key: no access.
illustrations.allDone: A tray of finished documents with a tick: all done.
illustrations.lost: Someone with a map at a signpost: this page does not exist.
illustrations.broken: A clock on its side with its spring out: something broke.
illustrations.forbidden: A closed gate with a padlock: access refused.
illustrations.welcome: An open door with someone waving: welcome.
illustrations.home: A small building with its flag up: home.
illustrations.success: Someone holding up a stamped document: success.
